title: auth_state_test.dart triplicates the same AuthState assertions across parallel groups

evidence.quote: test('displayIdentifier returns display name when present', () {

why: The 'AuthState' group (lines 88-199) and the three later groups 'AuthState.initializing' (201-210), 'AuthState.displayIdentifier' (222-254) and 'AuthState.copyWith' (256-306) each re-assert behavior the earlier group already covers, with only cosmetic renaming — 307 lines cover roughly what ~180 would. Every future field added to AuthState needs the same edit made twice to stay accurate.
recommendation: Delete the three later duplicate groups (or the earlier inline assertions) and keep one canonical group per behavior.
acceptance_criteria: No two groups in the file assert the same AuthState behavior
dart test on the trimmed file is green with the same set of distinct behaviors covered
